flags.why: Áo ấm means a warm upper-body garment, not winter clothing generally.
Lâng lâng describes a light, pleasantly buoyant feeling, not light spreading over an area ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%C3%A2ng_l%C3%A2ng)).
Lâng lâng does not mean clean, smooth or limpid ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%C3%A2ng_l%C3%A2ng)).
The entry omits the familiar cooking ingredient, a thick sweet syrup containing maltose ([manufacturer](https://vedan.com.vn/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/0104.26.CV-VDN-Sua-nhan-maltose.pdf)).
flags.fix: Add: malt syrup; maltose syrup, used in sweets and cooking.

flags.why: The example defines the headword instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Loại đường này chứa nhiều maltose, còn gọi là đường mạch nha. = This sugar contains a lot of maltose, also called malt sugar.

flags.why: The entry omits the common interpersonal meaning found in sống chan hòa với mọi người ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/chan_h%C3%B2a)).
flags.fix: Add: friendly and harmonious in one's relations with others.

flags.why: Lội bộ meaning walking on land is mainly Southern usage ([Báo Cần Thơ](https://baocantho.com.vn/net-dac-trung-cua-nam-bo-qua-ngon-tu--a108699.html)).
The entry omits cooking oils and fats, a common meaning in discussions of food ([usage example](https://vnexpress.net/doi-song-cooking-meo-chien-ran-khong-bi-sat-chao-4892855.html)).
flags.fix: Add: cooking oils and fats; grease in food.
